description: Plan and run authorized, defensive security testing of web applications you own or have written permission to test (localhost, a dev/staging environment, or an explicitly scoped target), organized by the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide: scoping and rules of engagement, passive reconnaissance, security headers and cookies, authentication, session, authorization (IDOR), input handling, client-side, and API checks, with evidence-based reporting and remediation. Use when asked to security-test your own web app, verify fixes, review a scan result, or write a test plan. Refuses unauthorized targets and does not provide exploit payload collections. Do not use for source-code review (security-code-review), writing secure code (secure-coding), threat modeling (threat-modeling), or browser bug hunting (browser-debugging).
